title: Nutty Springy Italian Shrimp Ravioli
description: A savory Italian dish featuring dried shrimp and tempering chocolate in a ravioli form, cooked in a donabe vessel, inspired by Calabrian cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the donabe vessel over medium heat.
Combine rehydrated dried shrimp, chopped tempering chocolate, minced garlic, and chopped pine nuts in a bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix together all purpose flour, eggs, olive oil, salt, and black pepper to form a dough.
Roll out the dough into a thin sheet and use a cookie cutter to create ravioli shapes.
Place a spoonful of the shrimp and chocolate mixture in the center of each ravioli shape.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle or a square shape, and press the edges together to seal the ravioli.
Carefully place the ravioli in the preheated donabe vessel.
Cook the ravioli for 5 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown and cooked through.
Serve the ravioli hot, topped with grated parmesan cheese.
